_about: John Kennedy of Dingwall (1819-1884), Free Church of Scotland minister: The Days of the Fathers in Ross-shire (fourth edition, Toronto and Montreal: Campbell, 1867; first published Edinburgh, 1861), the Highland evangelical ministers and 'the Men'. Named john-kennedy-dingwall: John Kennedy is a common name. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing. The Apostle of the North (Nelson, 1866) comes from lane A's round-11 copy of this shelf, merged 2026-10-03.
